key_highlights: ASX slumped as bond yields spiked and unemployment hit a 5-year high, signalling stagflationary pressure
RBA committed to further rate hikes despite deteriorating labour market, testing its credibility on inflation
AUD 'pulverised' by US economic outperformance, pressuring ASX foreign earnings and commodity exporters
Trump diesel export ban and drying global fuel buffers create energy cost shock risk for Australian consumers and transport
Property market weakening: rising listings, falling demand, and over half of renters financially stressed
Mining exploration active: Rio2 Peruvian copper drill, Auric high-grade gold at Munda, Forrestania 210k oz British Hill, Sarytogan 452m copper
Intergenerational Report 2026 flags urgent tax reform need, adding fiscal uncertainty
Jetstar industrial action escalates with staff waiving fees, hitting Qantas Group revenue

sectors.trend: Exploration momentum strong across gold and copper; Rio2 Peruvian drill, Auric Munda high-grade gold, Forrestania 210k oz British Hill, Sarytogan 452m copper, Lindian rare earths nearing production. However, AUD weakness and global demand uncertainty (Chinese property recovery question) cap upside.
sectors.implications: Exploration juniors (Aureka, Manhattan, Vista Gold) offer speculative upside; majors (BHP.AX, RIO.AX) face mixed signals from copper strength vs iron ore demand. Rare earths (Lindian) benefit from supply-chain diversification themes.

sectors.trend: RBA hiking into a 5-year unemployment high creates credit stress risk. Intergenerational Report flags fiscal deterioration. Bond yield spike pressures bank NIMs but also signals recession risk. ASIC referral of caravan company signals consumer credit stress.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face rising NPLs and provision pressure. Rate hikes support NIMs short-term but unemployment trajectory threatens loan book quality. Defensive positioning warranted.

sectors.trend: Trump diesel export ban and drying global fuel buffers create acute supply risk. Energy cost political dispute (Labor vs Coalition) unresolved. Nuclear energy debate intensifies. 'Energy hysteria' suggests market overreaction but underlying supply tightness is real.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WDL.AX, SXG.AX benefit from domestic energy security premium. Fuel cost pass-through pressures transport and consumer sectors. Nuclear policy shift could create long-term structural opportunity.

sectors.trend: Jetstar industrial action escalates; McDonald's grappling with Ozempic demand shift; Bentley EV at $325k signals luxury EV competition; Chinese 5-min EV battery threatens incumbents. Renters financially stressed; property demand falling.
sectors.implications: QAN.AX (Jetstar parent) faces revenue disruption. Consumer staples under pressure from energy costs. EV transition accelerates disruption to traditional auto. REITs (GPG.AX, ICPS.AX) face falling occupancy and rental stress.

sectors.trend: US AI chip race intensifies (Nvidia, AMD, Intel, Lumentum). Medicare hack bombshell raises healthcare data security concerns. Nine leadership change signals media sector restructuring.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, WES.AX healthcare exposure affected by Medicare policy. ASX tech names limited but global AI capex cycle supports sentiment. Media (NEG.AX) faces structural headwinds.

Global decoupling from US: 'world economy wary of America'

risk_assessment.mitigation: Favour domestic-revenue companies; reduce USD-earning exposure; consider AUD hedges

risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight REITs and construction; monitor housing data weekly

risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid QAN.AX short-term; monitor consumer discretionary names

opportunities.recommendation: Defensive healthcare and consumer staples positioning
opportunities.rationale: Stagflation environment favours inelastic-demand sectors; CSL global revenue diversifies AUD risk

defensive_moves.rationale: RBA hiking into 5-year unemployment high elevates NPL risk; Intergenerational Report flags fiscal stress
Falling property prices, rising listings, renter stress, and Bathla-style funding collapses signal sector weakness

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD exposure; favour domestic-revenue companies
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD 'pulverised' by US boom; foreign-earning ASX names face translation headwinds

market_outlook.short_term: ASX under pressure from bond yield spike, AUD weakness, and RBA hawkish stance. Expect volatility in financials and energy. Mining exploration names provide relative strength. Jetstar industrial action adds idiosyncratic risk. 1-3 month outlook: cautious, range-bound with downside bias.
market_outlook.long_term: Stagflation risk and fiscal deterioration (Intergenerational Report) create structural headwinds. Energy transition and rare earths supply chains offer medium-term themes. Property correction may extend 6-12 months. RBA credibility test is the pivotal variable. Mining exploration cycle supports selective upside.
